description: This header file defines the interface for managing protection metadata in the Rialto GStreamer plugin, including structure definitions, macros, and function declarations related to EME protection metadata.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing protection metadata associated with a GstBuffer, including a parent GstMeta and a GstStructure *info.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Returns the GType for the GstRialtoProtectionMetadata meta type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the GstMetaInfo for the protection metadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer with the provided GstStructure *info.
